final: WITH g AS (SELECT ds.raceId, r.circuitId, ds.wins - COALESCE(LAG(ds.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS gain FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId), pr AS (SELECT raceId, circuitId, AVG(gain) AS a FROM g GROUP BY raceId, circuitId), c AS (SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(pr.a) AS avg_w FROM pr JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = pr.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_w) AS m1 FROM c), k AS (SELECT c.country, c.avg_w FROM c, b WHERE c.avg_w > b.m1), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_w) AS m2 FROM k) SELECT k.country, k.avg_w AS average, k.avg_w - b.m1 AS above_benchmark, k.avg_w - m.m2 AS above_second_mean FROM k, b, m WHERE k.avg_w > m.m2
